intro
Nyambika Vision. A customer journey prototype for an AI powered fitting room, where every tailor, cooperative and seller keeps their own page.
splash
The app opens with a simple language choice: Kinyarwanda, English, or French.
home
Home is the Nyambika directory. Search, filter by tailors, cooperatives or sellers, and discover featured member pages.
search
Aline searches for a kitenge dress, and filters to items that support virtual try-on. Every result shows the page that owns it.
page
She opens Uwase Couture. This is the member's own page, with verification, reviews, services, and products.
product
The product page shows price, colours, sizes and the maker, with one main action: Try it on me.
consent
Before the first try-on, a clear consent screen explains that her photo is auto-deleted, and never shared with sellers.
camera
The camera guides her pose. On-device checks confirm full body, good lighting, and one person, before anything is uploaded.
generating
The AI generates her preview. Then a quality and fairness check verifies identity and skin tone, and content credentials are added.
result
Here is her try-on, clearly labelled as an AI preview. She switches colours and compares looks side by side.
wa
She shares the look with a friend on WhatsApp, with a watermark and a link back to the maker's page.
viewer3d
In release two, products can be explored in 3D, and viewed life size in augmented reality.
stylist
The AI stylist understands Kinyarwanda voice, and recommends real products from member pages, each ready to try on.
size
Her saved measurements suggest size M. She chooses delivery and Mobile Money. Payment goes directly to the maker.
momo
She approves the payment on her phone. The order is confirmed, and paid straight to Uwase Couture.
track
Order tracking shows every step, with WhatsApp updates from the maker. After delivery, she leaves a review.
privacy
In her fitting room and privacy centre, she controls saved looks and consents, and can delete her photos at any time.
vr
In release three, a virtual reality showroom lets shoppers walk through member booths and fashion shows, using WebXR.
outro
That is the structure: discover, member page, product, try-on, share, and order. Simple, private, and built around Rwandan makers.
